rec.name: Sticky Add-to-Cart Button
rec.status: Duplicate — ticket already exists (per comment); reference spec only

what.text: A sticky add-to-cart bar or button on the product page that stays visible while the user scrolls past the main product form. The ticket only says to rebuild the technical function of the standard Focal theme sticky add-to-cart 1:1. Details such as the bar's contents and trigger point are not specified in the ticket and are assumed to follow Focal's native behavior.

why.text: The purchase action stays within reach at all times, so users don't have to scroll back up after reading reviews, details or the description. This reduces friction and the effort needed to act at the moment of intent. A persistent price and CTA also keep the offer in view, which is especially useful on long mobile PDPs. This is general CRO reasoning and is not stated in the ticket.

how.text: Replicate the Focal theme's native sticky add-to-cart logic. The bar appears once the main add-to-cart button scrolls out of the viewport and hides again when it is visible. It typically shows a product thumbnail, title, price, a variant selector and the ATC button, and it submits the same product form. Check Focal's source (the product form / sticky bar section and its JS) and port it 1:1 so behavior matches the original. The ticket gives no code or screenshots, so the exact implementation is inferred.

items: Show/hide the sticky bar (theme-editor toggle, if Focal's native setting is carried over)
Visibility on mobile vs. desktop (assumed, not specified)
Bar content: thumbnail, title, price, variant selector (assumed from Focal's native behavior)

dependencies.text: Focal theme (the reference implementation is the standard Focal sticky ATC). No metafields or apps are mentioned. If the target theme is not Focal, the JS and Liquid for the product form must be ported.
